fields.statement: QA at 186386b0 with a scratch build (go build -o $TMPDIR/rhiza-qa ./cmd/rhiza) in a fresh git repo, fake rex on PATH, run env unset. Three accepted milestone change sets with leaves and hand-written journals: a succeeded ship-change run ending after the accept, a succeeded plan run ending after the accept, a succeeded ship-change run ending (2020) before the accept. rhiza daemon --once --max-runs=5 started runs of the plan and stale ones only (two rex window new calls) and skipped the shipped one. In a second repo on a feature branch: accepted, a succeeded ship-change journal ending after the accept, daemon --once skipped it as shipped; then rhiza land, commit, rhiza reopen --change <cs> --base main (landed -> accepted), and the next daemon --once started a run of it.

QA at 186386b0 with a scratch build in a fresh repo, fake rex: after daemon --once, rhiza daemon status printed 'Skipped: <cs> shipped: its latest run shipped it' for the change set whose latest run is a succeeded ship-change run after its accept, and daemon status --json listed it with reason shipped and detail []; the plan-run and pre-accept ship-run change sets were not among the skips. After a reopen the same change set was no longer skipped and was started.
